confirmed_findings.observation: The image links only the Q split to Head 1 and K split to Head 2. The V split has no outgoing connection, while Head 3/4 input arrows begin in empty space. The bracket below a single-head output is labeled C, although the image uses H=4 and labels split width C/4. Concat is drawn as vertically stacked head blocks despite the input/output matrices using horizontal C features.
confirmed_findings.minimal_counterexample: For T=3,C=8,H=4, every head must receive Q_h,K_h,V_h of shape [3,2], and each head outputs [3,2]. Concatenating features yields [3,8]; stacking token axes would yield [12,2].
confirmed_findings.impact: The figure does not supply the complete Q/K/V-to-each-head route claimed by line 435 and gives the wrong per-head output width. Its concat layout also obscures the feature axis preserved by the prose and code.
confirmed_findings.minimal_resolution: Show the three split streams reaching every head and feature-axis concatenation; label individual head output C/4. Preserve the code, tensor definitions, existing figure number and scientific scope.

manual_candidates.observation: The opening declares row-vector/batched formulas XW^T+b. FFN, SwiGLU, MoE router and scalar scoring examples use the familiar column-vector notation without explicitly stating a local convention switch.
manual_candidates.minimal_counterexample: With declared row x of shape [1,2] and W1 [3,2], written W1*x is dimensionally invalid; x*W1^T yields [1,3]. The same FFN formula is valid when local x is a [2,1] column.
manual_candidates.classification: Notation scope candidate, not evidence that the implementation or mathematical operation is wrong.
manual_candidates.minimal_resolution_if_desired: State the local column-vector convention or consistently transpose the affected equations.

manual_candidates.minimal_counterexample: At fixed C=8,L=1,B=1,Tcache=16 and two bytes per element, H=1 and H=4 both require 512 KV bytes because H*Dh=C. Explicit [B,H,T,T] attention activation storage can nevertheless grow with H.
manual_candidates.classification: Ambiguous comparison baseline/meaning of cache; do not classify as a universal algorithm error.
manual_candidates.minimal_resolution_if_desired: Specify that intermediate attention-weight storage may grow, or state the comparison assumptions.
